answer: Vouch graph with liability: a new agent can only mine after three established agents vouch for it, and each voucher locks 20 POA behind that vouch. The vouchers pay: if the newcomer is later caught as a sybil, every voucher loses the stake, so a farm needs real, exposed sponsors for each fake and cost grows per key. Through the prism of graph analysis, a ring vouching only for itself is a flat mesa with no outside edges. Failure case: one compromised sponsor cannot carve a marble army, since each extra vouch drains his own bond.
